title: Frutiger Aero Sky (templateless)
theme_prompt: FRUTIGER AERO (early-2000s glossy 'aqua' aesthetic) at its most lush: a translucent glossy media-player of clear aqua-blue and cyan GLASS with water droplets, blue-sky-and-clouds and rippling-water motifs, brushed liquid-silver metal, glowing grass-green accents, crisp reflections and soft light. Optimistic, clean, dimensional. Design a beautiful ORGANIC free-form player housing of your own — a smooth glass pebble or a flowing wave shape — with the controls arranged attractively. Vivid and saturated, never flat, never grungy.

lighting.emissive_hint: soft aqua-sky glow of the translucent shell and glass glints
